public_definitions: The goal is to review the public health laboratory dashboard and route this testing record to the operational follow-up that best matches the volume pattern shown over the reporting window.
The chart displays the number of samples tested over time, with the x-axis representing months and the y-axis representing the count in units of 10^6.

The options for routing the record are: 'Route the testing-volume record to rising-volume capacity planning', 'Route the testing-volume record to declining-volume outreach review', and 'Route the testing-volume record to general laboratory operations review'.
